chunks: 5627 - Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr al-Bazanti narrated, saying: Hammad ibn Uthman narrated to me from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdullah al-Basri, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
I said to him: My daughter has died while my mother is still alive. Aban ibn Taghlib said: She has no share. So Abu Abdullah عليه السلام said: Glory be to Allah! Give her a share, meaning one-sixth.

key_terms.أُمِّي حَيَّةٌ: the mother of the questioner being alive at the time of inheritance
key_terms.سَهْمًا: a prescribed share in the estate
key_terms.لَيْسَ لَهَا شَيْءٌ: the rejected claim that she has no inheritance share

ai.seo_question: What share does the grandmother receive in inheritance according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling in inheritance concerning the maternal grandmother when a daughter dies and the grandmother is living. Imam Abu Abdullah عليه السلام rejects the claim that she receives nothing and rules that she is to be given a fixed share, namely one-sixth.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5627 - Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr Al-Bazanti narrated, saying: Hammad ibn Uthman narrated from Abdur Rahman ibn Abi Abdullah Al-Basri from Abu Abdullah (as).

He said: I said to him, "My daughter has passed away while my mother is still alive."
Aban ibn Taghlib said: "She (the grandmother) has no share."
Imam (as) responded: "Glory be to Allah (swt)! Give her a share, meaning one-sixth."
